basic_details.scholarship_name: Mohamed bin Zayed University of Artificial Intelligence (MBZUAI) Full Scholarship
basic_details.offering_entity: Mohamed bin Zayed University of Artificial Intelligence (MBZUAI) & Government of Abu Dhabi
basic_details.host_institutions_covered: MBZUAI Campus (Masdar City, Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates)
basic_details.major_restrictions: Artificial Intelligence disciplines: Computer Vision (CV), Machine Learning (ML), Natural Language Processing (NLP), Robotics, and Computational Biology.
basic_details.number_of_awards_total: ~100% of admitted graduate students receive full scholarships (~150 to 200 admits/year)
basic_details.number_of_awards_pakistan: Open globally; Pakistan is one of the highest-represented international student cohorts at MBZUAI
basic_details.duration_of_scholarship: MSc: 2 years (4 semesters); PhD: 4 years (8 semesters)

nationality_requirements: International students of all nationalities (including Pakistan) and UAE nationals
eligibility_requirements.academic_qualifications: Completed 16 years of education (Bachelor of Science/Engineering) in STEM field (Computer Science, Electrical Eng, Math, Physics) with minimum CGPA 3.2 / 4.0.
eligibility_requirements.grading_conversion_notes: Minimum 3.20 / 4.00 CGPA; competitive admitted candidates typically present 3.50+ / 4.00 CGPA.
eligibility_requirements.subject_background_prerequisites: Strong background in mathematics (linear algebra, calculus, probability), algorithms, and programming (Python, C++).
eligibility_requirements.current_education_status: Graduated or in final semester of degree.
eligibility_requirements.work_experience_notes: Competitive programming (ICPC, Kaggle), AI hackathons, and published research papers in top AI venues (NeurIPS, ICML, CVPR, ACL, ICLR) carry decisive weight.

english_proficiency.notes: IELTS Academic minimum 6.5 (or TOEFL iBT minimum 90); official score report is mandatory.

eligibility_requirements.other_language_requirements: None; English is the official language of instruction and research.
eligibility_requirements.special_eligibility_categories: Candidates must take the mandatory online MBZUAI Entry Exam (math and coding assessment) and pass a technical faculty interview.

tuition_fee.details: 100% full tuition waiver for the entire duration of the MSc or PhD program.

admission_application_fee.details: Application on the MBZUAI online portal is 100% free of charge.

accommodation.details: Free luxury single-occupancy on-campus student housing in Masdar City (modern ensuite room with shared kitchen and gym).

monthly_stipend.details: Tax-free monthly living allowance paid directly to student.
monthly_stipend.amount: MSc: AED 8,000 / month (~PKR 610,000 / month); PhD: AED 10,000 / month (~PKR 760,000 / month)

airfare.details: Annual round-trip international flight ticket between home city in Pakistan and Abu Dhabi.

visa_fee.details: UAE student visa and Emirates ID processing fees fully sponsored by MBZUAI; eligible for UAE Golden Visa nomination.

health_insurance.details: Comprehensive UAE medical insurance coverage provided.

books_and_materials_allowance.details: High-end research laptop and access to world-class GPU clusters (thousands of NVIDIA A100/H100 GPUs) provided.

research_funding_conference_grant.details: Generous travel and accommodation funding provided for accepted papers at tier-1 AI conferences (CVPR, NeurIPS, ICML, ACL).

travel_transit_allowance.details: Free campus shuttle transit within Masdar City and to Abu Dhabi.

university_and_program_options.single_or_multiple_universities: Single institution: Mohamed bin Zayed University of Artificial Intelligence (Abu Dhabi, UAE).
university_and_program_options.university_rankings_scope: Ranked Top 20 globally in AI/CS (CSRankings in AI, Computer Vision, and NLP); world-class faculty recruited from CMU, Berkeley, Oxford.
available_majors: Computer Vision (MSc/PhD), Machine Learning (MSc/PhD), Natural Language Processing (MSc/PhD), Robotics (MSc/PhD), Computational Biology (MSc/PhD)
university_and_program_options.program_duration: MSc: 2 years (4 semesters); PhD: 4 years (8 semesters)
university_and_program_options.admission_requirements_summary: All admitted students receive the full scholarship package; admission requires passing online screening exam and faculty interview.
university_and_program_options.easiest_hardest_institutions_guidance: Machine Learning and Computer Vision are most popular; solid performance on the online math/coding exam is critical.
university_and_program_options.strategic_program_match_advice: Prepare thoroughly for the online entry exam in linear algebra, multivariable calculus, probability, and Python data structures.

application_process_roadmap.account_creation_instructions: Register on the MBZUAI portal (Opens September for Fall intake), fill in the application form, upload documents, and schedule online exam.
step_by_step_workflow: 1. Register on MBZUAI portal and select target AI degree program (September-December).
2. Upload Statement of Purpose, transcripts, CV, and English proficiency test score.
3. Submit contact information for two academic referees.
4. Complete the mandatory online MBZUAI Entry Exam (45 minutes: math and programming questions).
5. Shortlisted candidates invited for a technical video interview with faculty professors.
6. Final admission and full scholarship offer letter issued (typically by March/April).
7. Process UAE student visa and relocate to Masdar City in August.
application_process_roadmap.university_vs_scholarship_routing: Integrated single application; admission equals full scholarship.
application_process_roadmap.recommendation_letters_submission_method: Submitted online by referees via secure electronic link sent by MBZUAI.
application_process_roadmap.personal_statement_prompts: Statement of Purpose (500-1,000 words): Detail academic background, AI research interests, coding projects, and reasons for choosing MBZUAI.
application_process_roadmap.study_plan_research_proposal_requirement: Research proposal required for PhD applicants outlining intended research direction and literature background.
application_process_roadmap.cv_format_requirements: Detailed technical CV highlighting programming languages, GitHub links, Kaggle rank, and publications.
application_process_roadmap.interview_format_details: Rigorous 30-minute technical interview conducted by MBZUAI professors testing algorithms, linear algebra, and research projects.
application_process_roadmap.standardized_tests: Online MBZUAI Entry Exam is mandatory; GRE optional; IELTS Academic (6.5+) or TOEFL iBT (90+) mandatory.
application_process_roadmap.attestation_requirements: Degrees and transcripts must be attested by HEC Pakistan, MOFA, and UAE Embassy in Islamabad.

required_documents_checklist.specification: 500 to 1,000-word essay explaining background, passion for AI, and career vision
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Clearly articulated technical interests and project experience

required_documents_checklist.specification: Complete transcripts showing all courses, credits, and CGPA (min 3.2/4.0)
Submitted directly by university research professors or technical employers
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: From professors who supervised your AI, programming, or thesis work

required_documents_checklist.specification: Technical CV listing programming languages, frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow), and projects
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Include links to GitHub repositories and papers

important_dates_timeline.annual_cycle_notes: Early deadline is mid-December; regular international deadline is mid-January. Fall intake only.

selection_process_and_weights.research_experience_weight: 30% (Research publications, GitHub projects, hackathons, coding portfolio)
selection_process_and_weights.interview_weight: 25% (Performance on the MBZUAI entry exam and live faculty technical interview)
selection_process_and_weights.financial_need_weight: 0% (Completely need-blind; all admitted students receive the full scholarship)
selection_process_and_weights.selection_panel_composition: Faculty Admissions Committee and the Dean of Academic Affairs at MBZUAI.
selection_process_and_weights.evaluation_methodology: Rigorous three-stage sift: Document screening -> Online math/coding exam -> Technical faculty interview.

competitiveness_profile.acceptance_rate_pakistan: ~2% to 3% (Highly Competitive; Pakistani students are among the top cohorts)
competitiveness_profile.typical_academic_and_research_profile: Top computer science and electrical engineering graduates with solid math skills, competitive programming background, and AI publications.
competitiveness_profile.common_backgrounds_of_winners: Graduates of top Pakistani universities (FAST-NUCES, NUST, LUMS, GIKI, UET Lahore, ITU).
competitiveness_profile.high_representation_countries: China, India, Pakistan, UAE, Egypt, Russia, USA, Italy, Jordan.

fake_websites_and_scams: Unauthorized consultants claiming to provide 'MBZUAI exam leaks'; exam questions are dynamically generated.
red_flags_and_warnings.application_fee_warning: MBZUAI application is 100% free of charge on the official portal.
red_flags_and_warnings.agent_and_intermediary_warnings: Never work through agents; MBZUAI requires direct candidate examination and faculty interviews.
hidden_costs_breakdown: HEC, MOFA, and UAE Embassy attestation fees in Islamabad (~PKR 35,000).
misleading_claims_debunked: MYTH: You need Arabic. (Fact: MBZUAI is an international English-only research university).
MYTH: The scholarship is only for UAE citizens. (Fact: Over 85% of MBZUAI students are international from over 40 countries).
MYTH: You have to repay the stipend. (Fact: 100% non-repayable fellowship; graduates can work in UAE or anywhere globally).
official_vs_unofficial_discrepancies: Some websites advertise MBZUAI as a standard tuition waiver; it actually includes a massive monthly cash stipend of AED 8,000-10,000/month.

scholarship_obligations_and_terms.minimum_gpa_maintenance: Must maintain a minimum cumulative GPA of 3.0 / 4.00; falling below results in academic probation and potential scholarship loss.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.attendance_requirements: Full-time physical research residence in Masdar City, Abu Dhabi.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.academic_progress_monitoring: Semester credit reviews and annual dissertation progress milestones.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.work_restrictions_during_study: Scholars are expected to devote full time to their academic and research work.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.home_country_return_obligation: None; scholars are eligible for UAE Golden Visa sponsorship (10-year residency) post-graduation.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.repayment_clawback_conditions: Expulsion or voluntary withdrawal terminates funding.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.extension_policy: Funding is provided for normal program duration (max 2 years for MSc; max 4 years for PhD).
